what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 3: Push the proved no-memory region of the six-axis formation law up toward the located threshold. Blocks 08, 28 (PRs #8138, #8172): the six-axis formation law on Z^3 in level order is unique with exponential decay when the causal coupling contracts, 3c < 1 with c the one-site total-variation sensitivity; on the line (p,1,2) that region ends far below the executed threshold p in (10.5, 11). TASK: enlarge the proved region on (p,1,2). Candidates: (i) a block criterion over two or three levels (couple 2x2 blocks of the level plane jointly; compute the exact block sensitivity with rational arithmetic); (ii) disagreement percolation in level time: the set of sites where two coupled copies differ is dominated by an oriented percolation with an explicit density; uniqueness when it dies out; use rigorous oriented-percolation bounds you re-prove or the elementary path count 3^n q^n < 1 improved by exact small-block enumeration. Report the largest p you prove unique and the exact sensitivity matrices. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/uniqueness-region-up/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/uniqueness-region-up/<name>/check.py"
